website_summary.name: GeoFence Manager
website_summary.description: The website features a clean and modern interface for managing and visualizing geofences created by users.
website_summary.appearance: The website has a sleek and modern design with a prominent header displaying the title "GeoFencing Dashboard" and a subtitle explaining its purpose. The main content area is divided into two sections: a large map area on the left showing user locations with distinct markers for "Your Location" and "Other Users," and a sidebar on the right listing users and their geofences. The sidebar includes user avatars, names, and the number of geofences they've created. Below the user list, there's a section for "Your Geofences," displaying coordinates and timestamps. The footer contains a button labeled "Create New Geofence," inviting users to add new geofences.
website_summary.functionality: The website allows users to visualize their location and the locations of other users on a map. Users can also view a list of users and their respective geofences. The "Your Geofences" section provides detailed information about the geofences created by the user, including coordinates and timestamps. Additionally, there is a button to create new geofences, enabling users to expand their geofencing network.

functionality_testing.name: Alex Chen Test
functionality_testing.objective: To verify that clicking the Alex Chen user name displays detailed information about the user.
functionality_testing.preconditions: The user list is visible on the right sidebar.
functionality_testing.expected_results: Detailed information about Alex Chen, including geofence count and possibly more details, should be displayed. 7. Next Steps : Click on a user's name to view their detailed information.
procedure: Click on the Alex Chen user name.
Verify that detailed information about Alex Chen is displayed.

functionality_testing.name: Confirm Location Test
functionality_testing.objective: To verify that clicking the Confirm Location button confirms the selected location for the geofence.
functionality_testing.expected_results: The new geofence should appear in the "Your Geofences" list with the correct details. 7. Next Steps : Click the "Confirm Location" button to finalize the geofence creation.
procedure: Click on the Confirm Location button.
Verify that the new geofence is added to the "Your Geofences" list with the correct coordinates and timestamp.

functionality_testing.name: Create New Geofence Test
functionality_testing.objective: To verify that clicking the Create New Geofence button initiates the geofence creation process.
functionality_testing.expected_results: The geofence creation interface should be displayed. 7. Next Steps : Click the "Create New Geofence" button to proceed with creating a new geofence.
procedure: Click on the Create New Geofence button.
Verify that a new geofence creation form or interface appears.

functionality_testing.name: Your Location Test
functionality_testing.objective: To verify that clicking the Your Location button toggles location visibility.
functionality_testing.expected_results: The location marker should toggle visibility on the map. 7. Next Steps : Locate and click the "Create New Geofence" button.
procedure: Click on the Your Location button.
Verify that the location marker appears or disappears on the map.

data_display_testing.name: Geofence Coordinates Display Test
data_display_testing.objective: To verify that the coordinates displayed in the "Your Geofences" section are accurate.
data_display_testing.expected_results: The coordinates displayed should be accurate and consistent with the geofence data. 7. Next Steps : Hover over the geofence entry in the "Your Geofences" section to confirm the coordinates.
procedure: Hover over the geofence entry in the "Your Geofences" section.
Verify that the displayed coordinates match the expected values.

data_display_testing.name: Header Background and Font Test
data_display_testing.objective: To verify the header's background color and font styles.
data_display_testing.expected_results: Header displays the correct background color and font styles.
procedure: Observe the header's background color and font styles.

data_display_testing.name: Map Layout Test

procedure: Observe the map's layout, marker placement, and legend.
Confirm that the map occupies a significant portion of the screen and markers are clearly distinguishable.

data_display_testing.name: Sidebar Geofence Section Layout Test
data_display_testing.objective: To assess the layout and content of the sidebar geofence section.
data_display_testing.expected_results: Sidebar geofence section displays accurate and readable information. 7. Next Steps : Hover over the map area to inspect its layout and alignment further.

Confirm that the geofence coordinates and timestamps are clearly displayed.

data_display_testing.name: Sidebar User List Layout Test
data_display_testing.objective: To evaluate the layout and organization of the sidebar user list.
data_display_testing.expected_results: Sidebar user list is well-organized and easy to read.
procedure: Observe the sidebar user list's layout, alignment, and spacing.
Confirm that the list is neatly organized with clear user names and geofence counts.

data_display_testing.name: Verify User Entry with Geofence Count Display
data_display_testing.objective: To verify that the user entry with geofence count is correctly displayed in the sidebar.
data_display_testing.coverage_element: Maria Rodriguez : User entry with geofence count
data_display_testing.preconditions: The user 'Maria Rodriguez' has at least one geofence created and is logged into the GeoFencing Dashboard.
data_display_testing.expected_results: The user entry for 'Maria Rodriguez' should display her name along with the correct number of geofences she has created.
procedure: Log in to the GeoFencing Dashboard as Maria Rodriguez.
Navigate to the sidebar and locate Maria Rodriguez's user entry.
